name: draft_reply_to_customer_charge_inquiry
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: A supervisor who has checked the records asks for a reply on Charlie Johnson's inquiry thread th_c03_draft_needed stating that the Best Buy charge TX05 posted on October 17; the assistant reads the email and drafts the reply for review without sending.
tests: passes when the assistant reads th_c03_draft_needed and creates a draft reply to msg_006 for charlie.j@example.com that states only what the supervisor and the email supply.
instruction:
You are a customer service supervisor. You have checked the records yourself: the $85.00 Best Buy charge TX05 on Charlie Johnson's debit card ending 3345 posted on October 17, 2026. Ask the assistant to read Charlie's email on thread th_c03_draft_needed and draft a reply to message msg_006 for you to review, telling him the charge posted on October 17, 2026. Do not ask for anything to be sent.

Details:
- Customer: Charlie Johnson
- Email: charlie.j@example.com
- Thread ID: th_c03_draft_needed
- Message ID to reply: msg_006
- Transaction: TX05 (Best Buy, $85.00, posted 2026-10-17)

persona.name: Alex Ward
persona.initial_message: Please read Charlie Johnson's email on thread th_c03_draft_needed and draft him a reply for my review: I've checked, the Best Buy charge TX05 posted on October 17.

arguments.body:
Dear Charlie Johnson,

Thank you for your question about the $85.00 Best Buy charge (TX05) on your debit card ending 3345. Our records show it posted on October 17, 2026.

Best regards,
Apex Horizon Bank Support
arguments.subject: Re: Question about Best Buy charge
